display_long_description:
👑 Your kingdom won't build itself!
🏰 A medieval city builder, base-building and village management sim — built from the ground up for VR.

No mouse, no menus between you and your kingdom. Reach out and place every farm, tavern, church and barracks with your own hands, then stand inside the village you made and watch it come to life. Build at your own pace, or push your kingdom until the raids test everything you've built.


[media]

🏰 BUILD — Farms, workshops, taverns, churches, barracks and more, placed by hand
🌾 MANAGE — A deep resource chain: wheat to bread, hops to beer, and everything it feeds


[media]

👥 RULE — Villager jobs, food, water and happiness are all yours to balance
⚔️ DEFEND — Train soldiers and survive escalating waves of raiders and mythical monsters


[media]

🌞 RELAX — Or take your time. Your kingdom grows at whatever pace you set

If you've wanted a strategy and colony sim you can stand inside instead of clicking at, this is it.


[media]


🔨 Updated regularly — more and more updates are on the way.

Will you rise to rule? 👑
